climatology_period.note: Target rolling period; authoritative per-product periods below take precedence where source coverage is shorter

products.aggregation: sample classification then exact merge of integer counts and floating speed sums
products.encoding: legacy wind/fefe plus WEX1 calm/gale sidecar
products.name: wind atlas
products.summary: Six-hourly ERA5 10 m U/V samples classified into eight 45-degree meteorological wind-from sectors; frequency, conditional speed, calm and gale probability

products.aggregation: missing-aware component mean followed by component-wise bilinear resampling
products.encoding: legacy current/1 signed 8-bit components at 0.05 kn
products.name: ocean surface current
products.summary: OSCAR Final V2 daily total-current U/V monthly climatology
products.target_grid: 1/3 degree longitude, 1/3 degree latitude from 80N to 80S

products.aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
products.encoding: little-endian int16, 0.01 hPa, offset 1000 hPa, 32767 missing
products.name: mean sea-level pressure
products.summary: ERA5 monthly mean sea-level pressure climatology
products.target_grid: historical 90 x 180 grid at 2 degree spacing

products.aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
products.encoding: int8, 0.333333 degree C, offset 0 degree C, -128 missing
products.missing_policy: finite values outside the legacy representable range are missing
products.name: air temperature
products.target_grid: historical 90 x 180 grid at 2 degree spacing

products.aggregation: WMO-style saturation-vapour-pressure ratio, calendar-month mean, bilinear resampling
products.name: relative humidity
products.summary: Relative humidity derived from ERA5 monthly 2 m temperature and dew point
products.target_grid: historical 180 x 360 grid at 1 degree spacing

products.aggregation: rate conversion, calendar-month arithmetic mean, bilinear resampling
products.name: precipitation
products.overflow_policy: finite values above 50.8 mm/day saturate at 50.8; five target cells in this build
products.summary: ERA5 monthly mean total-precipitation rate converted to mean mm/day
products.target_grid: historical 72 x 144 grid at 2.5 degree spacing

products.aggregation: calendar-month arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
products.name: total cloud cover
products.target_grid: historical 90 x 180 grid at 2 degree spacing

products.aggregation: calendar-month missing-aware arithmetic mean then bilinear resampling
products.encoding: int8, 0.2 degree C, offset 15 degree C, -128 missing
products.name: sea-surface temperature
products.summary: NOAA OISST v2.1 monthly sea-surface-temperature climatology

products.aggregation: records grouped by storm and legacy theatre
products.name: tropical cyclone tracks
products.summary: IBTrACS v04r01 main-track positions at six-hour synoptic times
products.wind_convention: USA_WIND homogeneous one-minute series where present; unavailable otherwise

products.aggregation: median of negative source elevations in each target cell
products.name: bathymetric context
products.source_units: m relative to mean sea level
products.summary: GEBCO_2026 wet-cell median depth, contextual and explicitly not for navigation

products.name: lightning
products.summary: Retained observational NASA LIS/OTD HRMC v2.3.2013 monthly flash climatology

products.name: ENSO classification
products.summary: NOAA CPC historical three-month Oceanic Nino Index based on ERSSTv6

sources.name: ECMWF ERA5 hourly data on single levels
sources.transport: WeatherBench2 ERA5 0.25 degree Zarr through 2022 and ECMWF public ARCO Zarr for 2023-2024

sources.role: public cloud transport for ERA5 monthly MSLP, T2m, Td2m and precipitation rate

sources.name: NSF NCAR GDEX ERA5 monthly single levels
sources.role: public transport for ERA5 monthly total cloud cover
